Compared with the image of [[Scomp Link Access (V) (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c558ad6198b0ffe3de80ff2c229a729e1f0b2a87/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/scomplinkaccess.gif commit c558ad6]) and [[Scomp Link Access (V) (Errata 2)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d932d63eaf9566125177b6cd04770123a378792/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/scomplinkaccess.gif commit 3d932d6]).
